correctness.rationale: PASS: Read actual frozen RESULT.md (Git blob 5895d4d358c345f351588747026513d5743276fb) and characteristic-two truncated composition checker. For f=t+a2*t^2+... with a2 nonzero, the first nontrivial term of f^2 is necessarily even: commutation of f with f^2 gives the leading obstruction r*a2*b in degree r+1, impossible if r odd. The even coefficient E_(2j) is triangular with invertible coefficient a2 on a_(2j-1), and independent of later coefficients. Thus odd-indexed coefficients are uniquely determined for full lifts, even-indexed coefficients free; N=2m jets all lift, N=2m+1 jets have exactly one codimension-one next-coefficient condition. This yields the reduced G_m x A^floor((N-1)/2) geometry and both finite-field counts for every field of characteristic two. Independently recomputed F2 truncated composition at N=2..9 (depth-one/lift counts 1/1, 2/1, 2/2, 4/2, 4/4, 8/4, 8/8, 16/8). Finite examples corroborate but do not prove infinite-field result; nilpotent or nonreduced equation schemes explicitly excluded.
